#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Boundary-value tests."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.set_int_max_str_digits(8192)
SUB="/app/submission/main.py"; PY=sys.executable
fails=[]
def canon(v): return json.dumps(v, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=True)

def session(cfg, reqs, name):
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=canon(cfg).encode(),
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        fails.append((name,"compile",p.stdout[:200])); return None
    prog=json.loads(p.stdout)
    path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(prog))
    inp="".join(canon(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
    p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=inp,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        fails.append((name,"stream rc",p.returncode,p.stderr[:300])); return None
    return [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]

def check(name, cfg, reqs, expected):
    got=session(cfg,reqs,name)
    if got!=expected:
        fails.append((name,got,expected))
        print("FAIL",name)
        for i in range(max(len(got or []),len(expected))):
            g=got[i] if got and i<len(got) else None
            e=expected[i] if i<len(expected) else None
            if g!=e:
                print(" idx",i,"\n  got",canon(g)[:300],"\n  exp",canon(e)[:300])
    else: print("ok",name)

BIG_T = 2**53-1
BIG_F = 2**31-1
# extreme identifiers / values, max time
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":1,
     "rules":[{"id":BIG_F,"class":65535,"priority":2**31-1,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]},
              {"id":0,"class":0,"priority":-2**31,"ranges":[[2048,2048],[1,1]]},
              {"id":5,"class":3,"priority":-2**31,"ranges":[[0,0]]}],
     "fallback":{"class":65535}}
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":BIG_F,"time":0},
      {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":BIG_F,"time":BIG_T,"source":1,"length":2048},
                               {"flow":BIG_F,"time":BIG_T,"source":0,"length":1}]},
      {"op":"close","flow":BIG_F,"time":BIG_T}]
exp=[{"events":[]},
     {"events":[{"type":"match","flow":BIG_F,"rule":0,"start":0,"end":1},
                {"type":"match","flow":BIG_F,"rule":BIG_F,"start":0,"end":1},
                {"type":"decision","flow":BIG_F,"class":0,"reason":"key","at":1,"time":BIG_T,"rule":0},
                {"type":"match","flow":BIG_F,"rule":0,"start":1,"end":2},
                {"type":"match","flow":BIG_F,"rule":BIG_F,"start":1,"end":2}]},
     {"events":[{"type":"closed","flow":BIG_F,"packets":2,"matches":4,"class":0,"reason":"key","rule":0}]}]
check("extreme values", cfg, reqs, exp)

# idle at max time boundary: T - last == idle exactly -> no expiry; +1 -> expiry
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":1,
     "rules":[],"fallback":{"class":4}}
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
      {"op":"tick","time":10**9},
      {"op":"tick","time":10**9+1},
      {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":10**9+1}]
exp=[{"events":[]},{"events":[]},
     {"events":[{"type":"decision","flow":1,"class":4,"reason":"idle","at":0,"time":10**9+1,"rule":None}]},
     {"events":[{"type":"closed","flow":1,"packets":0,"matches":0,"class":4,"reason":"idle","rule":None}]}]
check("idle boundary", cfg, reqs, exp)

# 1024 packet chunk, error on the final packet only
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":5,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":1,"rules":[],"fallback":{"class":1}}
pk=[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":3}]*1023+[{"flow":2,"time":1,"source":0,"length":3}]
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},{"op":"chunk","packets":pk}]
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=canon(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
path=os.path.join(d,"p.json"); open(path,"w").write(p.stdout)
inp="".join(canon(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
p=subprocess.run([PY,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=inp,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
if p.returncode!=2 or p.stdout.splitlines()!= [b'{"events":[]}', b'{"error":"event"}']:
    fails.append(("late chunk error", p.returncode, p.stdout[-200:]))
else: print("ok late chunk error")

# 1024 packet chunk all valid
pk=[{"flow":1,"time":1,"source":0,"length":3}]*1024
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},{"op":"chunk","packets":pk},{"op":"close","flow":1,"time":2}]
got=session(cfg,reqs,"1024 chunk")
if got is None or got[1]["events"]!=[] or got[2]["events"][0]["packets"]!=1024:
    fails.append(("1024 chunk", got and [len(g["events"]) for g in got]))
else: print("ok 1024 chunk")

# zero-only rule never matches; wildcard-only rules always match
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":0,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":2,"rules":[
        {"id":1,"class":9,"priority":0,"ranges":[[0,0],[0,0]]},
        {"id":2,"class":8,"priority":0,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]}],
     "fallback":{"class":0}}
reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":1,"time":0},
      {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":1,"time":0,"source":0,"length":1},
                               {"flow":1,"time":0,"source":1,"length":1}]},
      {"op":"close","flow":1,"time":0}]
exp=[{"events":[]},
     {"events":[{"type":"match","flow":1,"rule":2,"start":0,"end":1},
                {"type":"decision","flow":1,"class":8,"reason":"key","at":1,"time":0,"rule":2},
                {"type":"match","flow":1,"rule":2,"start":1,"end":2}]},
     {"events":[{"type":"closed","flow":1,"packets":2,"matches":2,"class":8,"reason":"key","rule":2}]}]
check("zero range never matches", cfg, reqs, exp)
print("failures:",len(fails))
for f in fails: print("  ",canon(f)[:500])
PYEOF
